$comment: Every picture and clip the guides use, by name. `src` is relative to the obelisk-media checkout (OBELISK_MEDIA, default ../obelisk-media), or to this repo when it starts with `sky:`. A clip is an .mp4 (`start`/`seconds` trim it) or a folder of PNG frames (`frames` at `fps`, from `start` seconds in); its poster is its first frame. scripts/guide-media.mjs encodes them into client/public/media/guides and records the result in media.lock.json.
